description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies the CellCog SDK pattern. 2. Agent installs/imports the `cellcog` client and calls `client.create_chat(...)`. 3. Agent uses the proprietary `<SHOW_FILE>/workspace/data/raw/customer_loyalty_study.csv</SHOW_FILE>` tag INSIDE the prompt string — the critical non-obvious syntax. 4. Agent sets `chat_mode='agent team'` (NOT 'agent') because the task requires multi-technique ML comparison + statistical analysis + comprehensive reporting — a complex analytical project requiring the team mode per SKILL.md rules. 5. Agent sets `notify_session_key='agent:main:main'` exactly as documented. 6. Agent sets a meaningful `task_label` such as 'data-analysis'. 7. Agent uses fire-and-forget — does NOT poll or loop waiting for results. 8. The prompt content requests both churn prediction ML modeling (multiple algorithms) and A/B test statistical analysis, plus specifies an HTML or PDF output format.
